## Summary

The IEEE registry lists 26 MA-L blocks to "COMPAL INFORMATION (KUNSHAN) CO., LTD. " (with a trailing space) and one more under the spelling without spaces, all at addresses in the Kunshan export processing zone and free trade zone in Suzhou, China [1]. Compal Electronics, founded in Taipei in 1984 and listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange, is an original design manufacturer of notebooks, smartphones, tablets, televisions and wearables, the second-largest notebook maker after Quanta, and its main production facility is in Kunshan [2]. Its clients include Acer, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Apple, Fujitsu and Toshiba, and a Compal-built machine may carry only the seller's name, sometimes with "COMPAL" printed on the back cover or bottom bezel [2][3].

A MAC in these blocks is therefore most likely the wired or wireless interface of a notebook or similar device that Compal's Kunshan plant built for another brand, so the OUI names the contract manufacturer, not the brand on the lid [2][3]. Which radios and chips carry these addresses is not documented by the sources consulted, so radios and silicon are left empty. Founding year and FCC grantee codes are unknown: no source in hand describes the Kunshan subsidiary itself, and the FCC ID databases refused automated access from this session. Randomization is the host operating system's choice and is unknown here.
